content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Hindustan Prefab Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Hindustan Prefab Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Hindustan Prefab Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.hindprefab.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Hindustan Prefab Limited for filling various consultant positions on a contract basis across India.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in Hindustan Prefab Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Consultant (Finance) and Consultant (Civil Engineering) under the current notification cycle.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced in total?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for the Consultant - Finance and Civil Engineering posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates need to send their filled applications via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for Consultant (Finance)?
faq.answer: Applicants must be a Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost & Management Accountant (CMA/ICWA) with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the required qualification for Consultant (Civil Engineering)?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a BE, B.Tech, or Degree in Civil Engineering along with the required professional experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to these posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the maximum age limit for retired candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for retired candidates applying for these consultant positions is 63 years.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form along with documents should be sent to the Administrative Officer, Personnel & Administration Department, Hindustan Prefab Limited, Jangpura, New Delhi-110 014.
